summary: Read the face values on a hand of cards and an integer group size. The hand has between 1 and 10000 cards. Each face value is an integer from 0 through 1000000000. The group size is at least 1 and at most the number of cards. Decide whether the cards can be packed into groups that each use that many cards, with no card reused. Inside a group the face values must be consecutive integers, each appearing once in that group. Write true when such a packing exists and write false otherwise.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
